verdict.rationale: Autumn exposes a broad, well-documented API/CLI surface (attach, multiAttach, createSchedule, import, check, track, previewAttach, openCustomerPortal, licenses, atmn push/pull/preview/api) that mirrors most dashboard billing/entitlement operations, and even an MCP server for AI-assistant-driven billing actions, suggesting strong API-UI parity for an AI-native workflow. However there is no explicit vendor or independent confirmation that literally every dashboard capability (e.g. analytics views, log investigation UI) has a 1:1 API/CLI equivalent, and no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s on all candidate paths) to verify full surface coverage. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement/testing between dashboard UI and API, discoverable OpenAPI/full API reference, independent confirmation of complete coverage.
